notes: Leaving the app no longer kills the reply. Android freezes a backgrounded app and severs any in-flight connection — exactly what a slow photo-read invites you to do. Two fixes: the screen now stays awake while a reply or photo is generating, so setting the phone down doesn't lock, freeze, and kill it; and if the app does die mid-reply (switched away, process reclaimed), the next launch notices the reply never landed and automatically re-sends it — history and photo are all stored locally, so nothing is lost. Combined with 0.19.5's cold-start retries: send the photo, and the app keeps chasing the reply until it lands.
